definitions.explanation: The charge for delivering goods to the customer, especially in online shopping and food delivery. Often listed separately from the price of the product itself.

examples.japanese: {配送料|はいそうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧です。
⟦{合計|ごうけい}→合計：02817_goukei⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{配送料|はいそうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{加|くわ}わる→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧。
examples.english: A delivery fee is added to the total amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{配送料|はいそうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many shops waive the delivery fee once you buy above a certain amount.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧ (delivery, distribution) + ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (fee, charge). Standard term on shopping sites for the cost of shipping an order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配送料|はいそうりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: free delivery
- {配送料|はいそうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: a delivery fee applies
- {配送料|はいそうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: to include the delivery fee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧: postage; shipping — the most common everyday word; {配送料|はいそうりょう} sounds slightly more formal or business-like
- ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧: handling fee — a service charge, not specifically for delivery
